description: Should an agent open, sign or pay this link? Follows every redirect and checks the final site: domain age (RDAP), TLS certificate age and validity, look-alike and punycode domains, brand impersonation (PayPal, Coinbase, MetaMask, Phantom ...), risky TLDs, URL shorteners, raw-IP hosts, downloads, password and seed-phrase forms and wallet-drainer patterns. Returns a 0-100 risk score, a verdict (safe, caution, dangerous) and every signal explained. Heuristic, no blocklist. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"url_safety_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/safety?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Flogin
